description: General industry knowledge regarding Polypropylene (PP) polymer science, raffia extrusion, MFI, and UV stabilization.
notice: This information represents general industry packaging standards and must NEVER be attributed as specific Dwarkesh Polyfab plant capabilities unless backed by Layer A.

mfi.explanation: MFI measures the ease of flow of molten polymer. For PP woven raffia tape extrusion, MFI typically ranges from 3.0 to 4.5 g/10min to provide high tensile strength and burst resistance.

raffia_homopolymer.explanation: Polypropylene homopolymer resin designed specifically for tape stretching and weaving into high-strength woven sacks.

uv_stabilization.explanation: Hindered Amine Light Stabilizers (HALS) are added to PP tape masterbatches to prevent degradation from tropical ultraviolet sunlight during outdoor storage.

denier.explanation: Denier is the weight in grams of 9,000 meters of tape yarn. Higher denier yields stronger, thicker fabric suitable for heavy loads.

caco3_filler.explanation: CaCO3 masterbatch is blended into PP resin to adjust fabric opacity, reduce static, improve tape weaving stability, and optimize bag cost per quality grade.
